comments.author: ntnguyen1234
comments.body:
@livejamie Hi, can you test if these rules help on Adguard?

```adblock
sports.yahoo.com,fantasysports.yahoo.com#%#//scriptlet('json-prune', 'autoRecovery')
sports.yahoo.com,fantasysports.yahoo.com#%#//scriptlet('prevent-innerHTML', 'script', 'loadRecoveryScripts')
```
